# Repository instructions for Copilot

- Analysis work in this repo follows the `component-analysis` skill in
  `.github/skills/component-analysis/SKILL.md`. Read it before starting.
- Python 3.12, stdlib only. Run tests with
  `python -m unittest discover -s . -p "test_*.py" -t .`
- Never edit `codebase-analysis/plan.json` or anything under `tools/` or `.github/`.
